name: introspect-ai-benchmark
description:
IntrospectAI Benchmark Dataset
	

Empirical benchmark for measuring introspection in Large Language Models through activation steering experiments.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains trial results from 4 experiments (A, B, D, E) testing whether LLMs can monitor, report, and control their own internal states.

	
		
		Experiments
	


	
		
Experiment
Name
Question


		
detection
Injected Thoughts
Can the model detect when an external thought is injected?
